rejected.text: Skemfar is the elf realm of Kaldheim.
Skemfar is named as the elf realm whose sorcerers Tyvar boasts of and the home of the warriors whose code she follows.
It is described as the elf realm ruled by Harald.
The material records no events for Skemfar; it is last mentioned in 2023 as the elven realm of Kaldheim.
